title: Reports hub (administrator packs)
intro: Administrators use the same Reports hub as managers, with access to deeper packs: inventory, labor, products, and tax. Open a category, pick a report, set filters, then run or export.

sections.title: Administrator reports layout
steps: Categories on the left include Inventory, Labor, Products, Sales, and more.
The middle column lists reports in the selected pack; the right panel holds filters.
sections.caption: Reports hub for administrator packs.

sections.title: Inventory pack
sections.intro: Inventory reports cover stock on hand, purchases, issues, wastes, consumption, production, and buffet.
steps: Choose a report such as Current inventory or Purchase.
Set location and date filters, then run the report.
sections.caption: Inventory report pack.

sections.title: Inventory filters
steps: After choosing a report, the right panel shows its filters.
Adjust dates, locations, or item filters as needed.
Run or export when the filter set matches the question you need answered.
sections.caption: Filter panel for an inventory report.

sections.title: Labor pack
sections.intro: Labor reports summarize cost, overtime, attendance, payroll, and scheduled vs actual hours.
steps: Open Labor dashboard or Daily labor cost for high-level views.
Use Attendance or Payroll summary for people-cost detail.
sections.caption: Labor report pack.

sections.title: Products pack
steps: Use Product mix summary or weekly mix for item performance.
Products hourly shows velocity by hour for staffing and prep planning.
sections.caption: Products report pack.

sections.title: Tax report filters
sections.intro: Tax sits under Sales. Administrators use it to reconcile collected tax by period.
steps: Set the date range and any venue filters.
Run the report for filing or audit checks.
sections.caption: Tax report filter panel.
